name: Pedro For Elementor Addons
author: Mohammad Risad

sections.description:
Pedro For Elementor Addons is a lightweight and powerful plugin that adds custom Elementor widgets and features designed specifically for the Elementor theme.
Enhance your page-building experience with pre-designed widgets and styling options built to perfectly match the Pedro theme’s design system.

Features

  • Custom Elementor widgets built for the Pedro theme.
  • Lightweight and optimized for performance.
  • Seamless integration with Elementor and WordPress Customizer.

Widgets & Features Included

Pedro For Elementor Addons currently provides the following widgets and features:

  1. Accordion Widget
  2. Button Widget
  3. Team Widget
  4. Testimonial Widget
  5. Testimonial Navigation Widget
  6. Timeline Widget
  7. Custom CSS – applies global styles across all widgets

Notes

This plugin uses Elementor’s API to register and render custom widgets. No external dependencies or frameworks are required.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/pedro-for-elementor-addons directory, or install via WordPress dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure Elementor is installed and activated.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with any WordPress theme?

This addon is built specifically for the Pedro theme and may not work as intended with other themes.

Do I need Elementor Pro?

No, this addon works with the free version of Elementor. It is fully compatible with Elementor Pro as well.
